headline: Wildfire Resiliency goes before Board of County Commissioners Meeting on Wednesday, October 7
blurb: A full day for the BOCC. On the planning side, two public hearings: one on waiving land use application fees for the Town of Mountain Village's affordable housing project in the Ilium Valley — a question that signals how seriously the county is willing to subsidize the process, not just the construction — and a lot line adjustment for Lots 320A and 320B in the Lawson Hill PUD.
